brief: Iteration #62 built the boat's lantern (b59) and never landed it: a 37-line diff is in the working tree, uncommitted, with no ledger entry — `BOAT_LAMP_ON`/`BOAT_LAMP_FADE`, `boatLampF()`, `BOAT_LAMP` set by `drawBoat`, relit + haloed in `applyLight` after the multiply, a moving `column` in `drawRiverLights`, 'going downriver by lantern' in `livingAt`. Do NOT rebuild it. Read `git diff` first, verify it against b59's success criteria (crop at 22:00 vs HEAD at the pinned instant; `river-year.mjs` and `boat-wind.mjs` anchors unchanged; night filmstrip 0 POP), fix anything the verification finds, then decide the one thing #62 left open — whether `boatRate()` should thin after dark — state the boat's after-dark presence across 20 seeds either way, write #62's ledger entry as your own, commit. While in `drawChurchFront`'s neighbourhood: c99 — the rose window's disc colour is decided at cache time, so at the dusk edge it can sit grey for up to a quarter-hour before `ROSE`'s relight covers it; take it if it is a one-line fix, otherwise leave a cue.
successLooksLike: A commit whose diff is the working-tree lantern (plus at most a rate decision and c99); a 22:00 crop with a bow lamp and its column moving with the hull; anchors identical; a ledger entry that records the presence number.
avoid: Do not start from HEAD and rewrite the lantern. Do not add an R() draw. Do not touch the bridge shadow.
